messages:
sara: Heads-up — planning a blue/green shift for router v4.2.3 -> v4.3.0 in the change window at 23:00 UTC. Goal: staged traffic split with safety holds. Will run a 10m safety hold at 30% and an extended hold at 60%.

mike: @sara ok - what's rollback criteria?

sara: Rollback if p95 latency increases > 250ms OR error-rate spikes > 0.5% for 5m. Also abort on any sudden 5xx flood from edge.

deploy-bot: [deploy plan created] plan_id=pl_20260320_router_shift_01; steps:
```
- shift 20% -> wait 2m -> shift 30% -> hold 10m -> shift 60% -> hold 15m -> shift 100% -> drain v4.2.3
- rollback_on: latency_p95 > 250ms for 5m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m
- session_affinity: cookie -> pin to new by default
```

jordan: +1 to cookie pinning. Also add metric to watch: KB/s to cache tier — last time that killed us.

lee: Suggest adding a manual gate at 60% to confirm billing spike isn't correlated with app metrics. If teams give :thumbsup: within hold we continue.

mike: I'll be on-call for the window. If deploy-bot triggers rollback alert I'll run the rollback playbook. Ping me @mike.

sara: I'll push release notes to #releases in 30m and create an opt-out flag in the router for tenants with strict SLAs.

deploy-bot: scheduled start=2026-03-20T23:00:00Z; estimated duration=40m; rollback_timer=5m; notify_channels=[eng-releases, oncall]; owner=sara

jordan: Quick command we'll run if we need a soft pause:
```
/route split router v4.3.0 60% --hold
```

mike: If rollbacks happen, prefer a gradual revert 50->0 over 10m rather than all-at-once to avoid cache stampede.

sara: Agreed. Final checklist: docs, canary logs streaming to s3->watcher, deploy-bot alert thresholds double-checked. Anyone object?

lee: no objections. :thumbsup:

mike: :heavy_check_mark: oncall ready.

deploy-bot: note: preflight checks pass (connections healthy, pool warm, kv-cache primed)

sara: OK proceeding. I'll post the shift command at start time and update thread with progress. Keep comms here for rollback decision.

mike: I'll be in the thread during the rollout.

jordan: leaving a short runbook snippet in the thread:
```
1) watch /metrics/router/p95
2) if p95>250ms for 5m -> /route revert router v4.2.3 100%
3) if errors>0.5% -> contact infra + rollback
```

deploy-bot: executed preflight @2026-03-20T22:55:00Z

sara: thanks everyone. See you at 23:00 UTC.
